name: WefieHome Airbnb management (short-term rental management)
description: Full-service short-term rental (Airbnb) management for unit owners in Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley: setup advice, listing, pricing, guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, inspections and monthly reporting.
audience: Unit owners in Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley

services.name: Property assessment and setup advice
services.description: We review the unit and advise on setup, layout and furnishing priorities before launch.

services.name: Photography
services.description: Professional listing photography arranged before the unit goes live.

services.name: Airbnb listing creation and optimisation
services.description: Listing copy, photos, amenities and settings created and kept optimised.

services.name: Pricing strategy
services.description: Nightly rates adjusted for weekdays, weekends, school holidays, events and demand.

services.name: Guest communication and screening
services.description: Guest enquiries and messages handled; guests screened against house rules.

services.name: Check-in and check-out coordination
services.description: Check-in instructions and check-out coordinated for every stay.

services.name: Cleaning and linen coordination
services.description: Cleaning, linen changes and restocking after every stay.

services.name: Maintenance coordination
services.description: Issues assessed, owner informed, repairs coordinated and completion checked.

services.name: Property inspections
services.description: Checkout inspections and random supervisor checks.

services.name: Damage reporting and claims
services.description: Damage documented and reported or claimed through the appropriate channel.

services.name: Monthly owner reporting
services.description: Monthly report on revenue, costs and owner payout.

pricing.note: Exact terms follow the signed management agreement.
